calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-20-2005 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Noreen Ikeuye #3538.
Petitioners: Diem Pham and Paul Pham, are present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Quan Minh Pham.
Paul Pham is also serve as Vietnamese Interpreter from Diem Pham.
Petitioners and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
Order Dispensing Notice to Minor's biological father, granted and signed in court.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Thomas Gia Phan.
Decree signed in open court.
